program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready establishment file for a single reference period by merging the control file onto collected microdata, keeping only responsive (R/N) records, and computing a hires rate per 100 employees. Also sums employment and hires by state into a review table.

macro_reference.name: gen_est
macro_reference.purpose: Joins the control file D2 onto raw microdata D1, retains only response codes R/N, derives the hires rate per 100 employees, and writes WORK.O1 plus the by-state summary for reference period `p`.
